description: Source code for HttpAuthHandlerDigest class implementing Digest authentication handling, including nonce generation, challenge parsing, and credential assembly, based on RFC 2617.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest

methods.description: Parses the WWW-Authenticate challenge header to extract parameters.

methods.description: Parses individual key-value pairs from the challenge header.

methods.description: Extracts HTTP method and request path from the request object.
